summary.text: A large Italian ship scuttled in 1940 near Wingate Reef, close to Port Sudan. It rests tilted on its port side with the top only a few metres down, still carrying its wartime cargo, and is regarded as one of the Red Sea's best wreck dives.

s1.quote: at Sha’ab Rumi off Sudan … The rest became undersea destinations for recreational divers.

s2.quote: The remains of this Sudanese underwater village litter the sea floor.

summary.text: Remains of Cousteau's 1960s undersea habitat project on the Sha'ab Rumi reef off Sudan. Two structures were removed afterwards; the rest, including the submersible hangar and shark cages, is now a diveable relic.
